creator: Navneet Prabhakar
authorization: this is a simple problem statement, you can review as expert
population: The complete hash-bound staged iteration-two candidate population, after official/frozen holdout protection and exact/near grouping.

selection.method: Existing quality_audit seeded bottom-k whole split groups per source/task/content/partition/length stratum
selection.inclusion_probabilities: Retain actual group N, k and k/N from the frozen audit; selected paths within a group are correlated.

review_rules: Read every message in each judged path, including earlier assistant history. Mark unread or partially read rows ungraded; never infer a grade from rank, detector labels or a snippet.
Record English comprehensibility, coherence, response relevance, context preservation and instruction-following failures separately from privacy and content categories.

For bounded conversation SFT suitability, reject wrong arithmetic, contradicted supplied facts, broken requested formats, incoherent answers, missing-context continuations or fabricated unsupported identities/capabilities.
Treat fact-sensitive or current medical/legal/financial claims as unresolved for this first SFW research slice unless independently verified. Unresolved does not mean false.

Flag identifying private details, credentials and unsafe-content concerns explicitly. Pattern presence is only a candidate; absence is not clearance. Do not reproduce private values in public reports.
Profanity, slang and caveman grammar are not automatic quality failures. Mature content needs its own category decision and is deferred from this first SFW slice rather than silently relabelled.
Keep raw node evidence and staged normalization/redaction differences visible. Do not repair source text inside an approved example or substitute an ideal response.
Give each judged path a reason and input hash. Entire-group outcomes may be reported only after all group members have been read. Preserve ambiguous and rejected records.
inference_limits: This is a development sample review, not source-wide approval or an accepted corpus error bound. Report stratum denominators and clustered/unequal selection. Additional review or a separately justified bounded research admission policy is required before training unsampled rows.
